convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iCustom call to SpearmanRankCorrelation indicator (which is a standard MQL5.com community indicator with straightforward histogram logic). Simple entry/exit rules based on histogram sign change. Fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. No hedging, grid, or martingale.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: EA uses Spearman Rank Correlation histogram values. When histogram crosses above zero, a BUY is triggered; when it crosses below zero, a SELL is triggered. The opposite position is closed before a new one is opened. SL and TP are set in points (not pips), so the actual pip value depends on the symbol's _Point. The EA checks for new bar formation to avoid multiple signals per bar. Uses previous bar indicator values (shift=1) for signal confirmation to prevent repainting.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Spearman Rank Correlation can be reimplemented in Python using scipy.stats.spearmanr on rolling windows, or manually via rank correlation formula. Entry is simply histogram sign change across zero line. SL/TP are fixed point values. New-bar guard maps to resampled bar data. No special MT5-specific features needed beyond standard order placement.
